judged_text: PostRevisor.new(post) with no nil guard crashes if embed.post_id points at a deleted post (app/models/topic_embed.rb:23-24)

record.issue_text: PostRevisor.new(post) with no nil guard crashes if embed.post_id points at a deleted post (app/models/topic_embed.rb:23-24)

adjudication.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, when an embed already exists it does `post = embed.post` and then (on content change) unconditionally does `revisor = PostRevisor.new(post)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb, else branch). Since TopicEmbed has `belongs_to :post` but no validation for presence of `post` (only `embed_url` and `content_sha1` are validated) and there’s no FK constraint shown, an orphaned `topic_embeds.post_id` (e.g., post deleted) would make `embed.post` nil, causing `PostRevisor.new(nil)` to crash.
